subject: Taxes
title: Thatcher's Poll Tax Disaster
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Thatcher's Poll Tax Disaster.

hook.text: In 1990, riots erupted across Britain over Margaret Thatcher's poll tax.

buildup.text: The Community Charge replaced property-based rates with a flat per-person tax. Rich and poor owed the same sum.

discovery.text: 200,000 people marched in London. The Trafalgar Square riot saw burning cars and running battles with police.

twist.text: The poll tax destroyed Thatcher's premiership. She resigned months later. Her successor immediately abolished the tax.

climax.text: Thatcher's poll tax proved that the Peasants' Revolt lesson still applies: flat per-person taxes are political poison.

punchline.text: Same tax for duke and dustman. 600 years later, same outcome.

quiz.question: What ended Margaret Thatcher's time as Prime Minister?
options: A party vote unrelated to taxes
